scenarios.title: Subscriber calls: 'I can't browse'
scenarios.description: A single subscriber cannot reach the internet. Walk through the diagnosis and fix.

steps.situation: A customer calls in. Their phone shows 4G but no pages load. Other customers on the same site are fine. What's your first move?

choices.text: Ask for the IMSI and MSISDN, then open the subscriber profile
choices.explain: You can't troubleshoot without a subscriber identity. Capture IMSI, MSISDN, APN, and node in the Subscriber Context panel before doing anything else.

choices.text: Restart the UGW to clear the issue
choices.feedback: Never restart a live node for a single subscriber.
choices.explain: A UGW restart affects thousands of subscribers. Single-subscriber issues are almost always profile, APN, or session-related.

steps.situation: You have the IMSI and open the HSS profile. You run LST OPTGPRS. The subscriber has no APN listed. What now?

choices.text: Add the APN to the profile with a change ticket
choices.explain: APN provisioning is a production change. Get the change ticket approved, then run MOD OPTGPRS / ADDPDPCTX.

choices.text: Tell the subscriber to reboot their phone
choices.feedback: Rebooting won't add a missing APN.
choices.explain: A missing APN on the profile is not a device issue.
